properties.title: NRC Report: Mercury near Cranston, RI
properties.summary: Incident Type: FIXED - NRC Report ID: 834252 - Medium Affected: OTHER - Suspected Responsible Party: CRANSTON HIGH SCHOOL EAST
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 834252
Incident Time: 2007-05-02 15:00:00
Nearest City: Cranston, RI
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: MERCURY
Medium Affected: OTHER
Suspected Responsible Party: CRANSTON HIGH SCHOOL EAST
Skytruth Analysis
CALLER REPORTED THAT A STUDENT FOUND MERCURY IN THE BOOK STORAGE AREA WITHIN CRANSTON HIGH SCHOOL. WITHIN MINUTES OF TEACHER BEING NOTIFIED, POLICE & FIRE DEPARTMENTS WERE CALLED TO THE SCHOOL. AREA WAS EVACUATED AND ROPED OFF AND WINDOWS WERE OPENED. FIRE DEPT SAID THAT THE STUDENTS COULD STAY INSIDE OF THEIR CLASSROOMS UNTIL BUSES ARRIVED TO TAKE THE 1800 STUDENTS FROM THE SCHOOL. STUDENTS THAT MIGHT HAVE COME IN CONTACT WITH THE MERCURY WERE INTERVIEWED. 3 STUDENTS THAT WERE EXPOSED TO THE MERCURY WERE TAKEN TO HASBORO CHILDRENS HOSPITAL. STUDENT WERE DISMISSED FOR THE DAY. SCHOOL WILL BE CLOSED FOR THE REST OF THE WEEK FOR CLEAN UP.

properties.title: NRC Report: Transmission Fluid,  Antifreeze, Oil near Luray, VA
properties.summary: Incident Type: FIXED - NRC Report ID: 817262 - Medium Affected: OTHER - Suspected Responsible Party: RED'S TIRE AND AUTO SERVICE INC.
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 817262
Incident Time: 2006-11-06 16:50:00
Nearest City: Luray, VA
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: TRANSMISSION FLUID, ANTIFREEZE, OIL
Medium Affected: OTHER
Suspected Responsible Party: RED'S TIRE AND AUTO SERVICE INC.
Skytruth Analysis
CALLER REPORTS A DISCHARGE OF OIL, ANTIFREEZE, AND TRANSMISSION FLUID FROM STORAGE TANKS OF AN AUTOMOTIVE FACILITY, TO THE FACILITY STRUCTURE WALLS, FLOOR, SOIL, AND POSSIBLE WATER SUPPLY. THE INCIDENT IS DUE TO AN ON-GOING LEAKAGE FROM THE CONTAINERS WHICH HAVE BEEN FUNCTIONING TO STORE THE MATERIAL AS EARLY AS JANUARY OF 2006. THERE ARE BETWEEN TEN AND TWELVE 55 GALLON DRUMS, AND ONE HUGE SILVER CONTAINMENT WITH A POSSIBLE CAPACITY OF 150 GALLONS. ANTIFREEZE, CAR OIL, AND TRANSMISSION FLUID ARE KNOWN MATERIALS TO HAVE BEEN DUMPED INTO THESE CONTAINERS DURING NORMAL OPERATIONS. CALLER REPORTS BEFORE JANUARY 2006, THE BUILDING SAT DORMANT FOR 1.5 YEARS. THE CURRENT OWNER BOUGHT AND OPENED IT JUST AFTER JANUARY OF 2006. THE LEAK FROM THE CONTAINER(S) HAD BEEN ON-GOING AT THE TIME NEW OWNERSHIP TOOKOVER, HOWEVER THIS WAS NOT APPARENT BECAUSE THE PREVIOUS OWNER HAD PLACED TIRES ON THE FLOOR COVERING THE AFFECTED AREA. THE LEAK HAS SINCE BEEN ON-GOING, AND THE OIL AND FLUIDS HAVE SINCE GONE THROUGH THE STRUCTURE WALL, AND INTO SOIL. CALLER REPORTS THE LEAK STARTED ON THE TOP FLOOR (1ST FLOOR). THE MATERIAL APPEARS TO TRAVEL FROM THE RIGHT SIDE OF THE BUILDING ROOM TO ITS LEFT SIDE, WHERE IT SEEPS OUT OF THE LEFT EDGE OF THE BUILDING AND INTO THE GROUND. WHEN YOU WALK THROUGH THE BASEMENT AREA, YOU MUST BE CAREFUL BECAUSE THERE ARE POOLS OF OIL ON THE FLOOR DUE TO THE LEAKAGE. THE MATERIAL CAN ALSO BE SEEN ON THE BASEMENT WALLS, AND UNDERNEATH THE LIFT ON THE 1ST FLOOR. CALLER STATES AS YOU ENTER THE ROOM ON THE 1ST FLOOR, THE CONTAINERS CAN BE SEEN TO THE LEFT OF A HUGE, SILVER CHEST. WHEN YOU WALK THROUGH THE ROOM AND DOWN THE STAIRS, THE SEEPAGE CAN BE SEEN COMING DOWN THE CINDER BLOCK, CONCRETE WALL.
